name: cmdb_ci_auth
label: Configuration Item Authorization Table in CMDB
description: Configuration item authorization table used for configuration management-related association queries and reporting queries.

fields.name: ci_id
fields.description: Reference the ID from the ecmdb_ci, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Role name, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The corresponding action, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: Auth UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ci_id, auth_type, action, auth_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.
